name: minecraft-llm-bot
description: Autonomous, personalizable Minecraft Java bot driven by a local LLM (Ollama + Qwen 2.5) using Mineflayer and mineflayer-pathfinder.

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check actions.js && node --check social.js && node --check emotions.js && node --check learning.js && node --check tasks.js && node --check combat.js && node --check knowledge.js && node --check building.js && node --check util.js && node --check intelligence.js && node --check senses.js && node --check containers.js && node --check doctor.js
scripts.update-mc: npm install mineflayer@latest minecraft-protocol@latest minecraft-data@latest mineflayer-pathfinder@latest
